title: Explainer lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Explainer templates were built and verified in: cause and effect, pros and cons, labelled diagram, icon steps, FAQ card, word definition, tip carousel and problem and solution.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 explainer template working before using it, copy a comp's objects (a seesaw baked to the beam, an accordion that opens, a carousel whose cards never overlap), or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.

comps: EX Pros cons (165 f, seesaw baked)

parameters: colours (linear light; BT.709 curve, deeper accents that pass contrast)
text content (sample copy: names, numbers and claims are invented)
pros and cons: TILT angle and ball sizes (regenerate; positions are baked every frame)
tip carousel: slide frames (f_slide) and card size
FAQ: which row opens (shift and panel)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The phone in the labelled diagram is a shape stand-in.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction) and a 'Light background' that stays in the template.
Clip ids are unique per comp (ece_, epc_, eld_, eis_, efq_, ewd_, etp_, epb_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/explainer_lab3.py writes the comps; every move is baked as keys (no presets to apply); open with edit.open {force:true}, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings with contrast:true (notes: repeated_key_value on holds, speed_jump on slides and the tilt; intended).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
